Implemented all 3 milestones in order:
- m1: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturalday - added check for tzinfo and uses datetime.now(value.tzinfo).date() instead of date.today()
- m2: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturaldate - same tz-aware "today" computation for the five-month threshold check
- m3: Return empty string from natural_list for empty list - added guard before length-based branches

All 684 existing tests pass after each commit. Exactly 3 commits on top of base.
